name: amfx-eurjpy-hyg-bear-stearns-research
description: amFX reproduction (16JUN22 p5): EURJPY vs HYG during Bear Stearns crisis (Feb-Apr 2008). Forced liquidation case study -- when JPM bought Bear Stearns and liquidated ~10B EURJPY over 3 days, EURJPY completely decoupled from risk assets. HYG and risky assets made a V-bottom while EURJPY kept getting hammered. Z-score normalized overlay shows the divergence.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: EURJPY VS HYG BEAR STEARNS CRISIS (16JUN22 p5)
# =============================================================================
# Legendary forced-liquidation case study from Brent Donnelly.
# Feb-Apr 2008: JPM buys Bear Stearns for $2/share, liquidates ~10B EURJPY.
# EURJPY decouples from risk assets for days -- HYG V-bottoms but EURJPY
# keeps getting hammered by forced selling that ignores correlations.
#
# Z-score normalization puts both on same scale for visual overlay.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
hyg_close = src.c

# EURJPY from fx_pairs
eurjpy = fx_pairs(ticker='EURJPY')()
eurjpy_close = eurjpy.c

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# Normalize both for overlay
# =============================================================================
hyg_z = zscore(window=60)(hyg_close)
eurjpy_z = zscore(window=60)(eurjpy_close)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Normalized Overlay (Z-Score)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='EURJPY vs HYG: When Forced Selling Breaks All Correlations',
    category='Bear Stearns Crisis',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (60d)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EURJPY (Z-Score)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='HYG High Yield (Z-Score)', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, eurjpy_z, hyg_z)
